people.name: Daniel
people.line: Prophet in Babylon, known for wisdom and visions

translations.web: When I, even I Daniel, had seen the vision, I sought to understand it. Then behold, there stood before me something like the appearance of a man.
translations.bsb: While I, Daniel, was watching the vision and trying to understand it, there stood before me one having the appearance of a man.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, when I, even I Daniel, had seen the vision, and sought for the meaning, then, behold, there stood before me as the appearance of a man.
translations.asv: And it came to pass, when I, even I Daniel, had seen the vision, that I sought to understand it; and, behold, there stood before me as the appearance of a man.
